gym.redstone.working.help: Emits 15 while the gym is generating power; otherwise 0.
gym.title: Animal Gym 2.0
gym.food.no_animal: Add an animal to see energy per food.
gym.food.unsuitable: This animal does not eat this food.
gym.status.waiting: Lead an adult onto the belt
gym.help: Lead a supported adult animal onto the belt, or insert an occupied Critter Courier to keep it contained. Supply its food and connect an FE consumer. When full, the gym rests until energy drops to 75%; it keeps exporting power without spending food. The right side holds the belt and the top holds the hanging food; neither supports side or redstone connections. Remove the courier to take the animal with you. Use the run control to pause or resume.
gym.release.tip: Release a loose animal, or return its occupied courier.
courier.title: Critter Courier
courier.release_failed: Cannot restore this mob here. Its data remains safe in the courier.
courier.release.tip: Release the mob into clear space beside the cage.
courier.pickup.tip: Pick up this courier with its occupant safely inside.
courier.no_space: Clear space next to the courier before releasing the mob.
gym.trap.help: Insert an occupied courier. Remove it to take the animal with you.
gym.status.unsupported: This mob cannot power the gym
jei.industrial_overkill.gym.title: Animal Gym
jei.industrial_overkill.gym.selector_too: Click to cycle intensity: 1 → 2 → 3 → 1. Updates all animal previews and food rates.
industrial_overkill:rock_stew_factory.in: Fill once with one bucket each of water and lava, then supply FE. Both fluids are reusable catalysts. Produces one cobblestone per 40 processing ticks for 320 FE. Pause before removing catalysts. Output and energy/fluid sides are configurable.
